Today, Apple TV released the trailer for the fifth season of "Stillwater," the Peabody and Emmy Award-winning mindfulness series on the platform. Watch it below.

"Stillwater" returns on August 21

A few days ago, Apple TV confirmed the premiere date for the fifth season of "Stillwater," with all five episodes dropping simultaneously on August 21.

According to Apple TV, the new season of "Stillwater" will feature more "breathing exercises, mindfulness moments, and simple everyday practices," continuing the show's mission of helping children and their families find inner peace.

"Stillwater" originally premiered on Apple TV in 2020 and has since won a Daytime Emmy Award for Outstanding Editing in a Preschool Animated Program and a Peabody Award in the Children's/Youth category.
